common.encryption: Messages are stored on Sunnsteel's servers and aren't end-to-end encrypted.
common.routineUnavailable: A routine that's no longer available
common.workoutUnavailable: A workout that's no longer available

list.emptyHint: Start one with Message on a member's profile.
list.restrictedNote: Moderation has restricted your messaging. You can still read and delete messages, and others can still write to you.
list.requestsEmptyHint: When someone you don't follow writes to you, their first message waits here.

thread.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or you can no longer reach this member.
thread.deletedMemberNote: This member deleted their account. You can no longer write here.
thread.unavailableNote: You can't send messages right now.
thread.deleteMessageBody: It's removed for both of you, and "Message deleted" stays in its place.
thread.deleteConversationBody: It leaves your list and its messages are hidden from you. {name} keeps them. If they write again, it comes back with only the new messages.
thread.deleteConversationBodyDeleted: It leaves your list for good.
thread.blockHint: To stop someone writing to you, block them from their profile.
thread.restrictedNote: Moderation has restricted your messaging, so you can't send messages. You can still read and delete them.
thread.hiddenFromOther: Hidden from {name} by moderation. Only you can see it.
thread.requestIncoming: {name} wants to message you. They can't send more until you accept.
thread.requestFollowHint: Accepting moves the conversation to your inbox. Declining removes it; {name} isn't told.
thread.declineBody: {name} isn't told. They can't send you another request for 30 days.
thread.requestOutgoing: Your request is sent. You can write more once {name} accepts it.
thread.routineMeta: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {exercises, plural, one {# exercise} other {# exercises}}
thread.routineGone: This routine is no longer available.
thread.workoutGone: This workout is no longer available.

composer.label: Write a message
composer.keyboardHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
composer.attachTitle: Attach a routine or a workout
composer.attachDescription: The other member can open what you send, whatever your privacy settings, until you delete the message. A routine can be copied; a workout shows its totals, records and sets, never your notes.

new.unavailableHint: They may not be taking messages from you, or the profile isn't available.
new.missing: Choose a member to message from their profile.
new.restricted: Moderation has restricted your messaging, so you can't start a conversation.
new.asRequest: This goes to {name}'s message requests. You can write more once they accept it.

settings.title: Messages
settings.description: Who can write to you, and how your messages are kept.
settings.legend: Who can start a conversation with you
settings.followedHint: Members you follow can start a conversation with you.
settings.nobodyHint: No one can start a new conversation with you.
settings.existingNote: Conversations you already have keep working. To stop someone writing to you, block them.
settings.everyoneHint: Members you follow reach your inbox. Anyone else's first message waits in Requests until you accept it.

routine.unavailableHint: The message or the routine may have been deleted.
routine.sentToYou: {name} sent you this routine. You can open it and make your own copy until the message is deleted.
routine.yours: This is your routine, as you sent it in this conversation.

workout.unavailableHint: The message or the workout may have been deleted.
workout.sentToYou: {name} sent you this workout. You can open it until the message is deleted.
workout.yours: This is your workout, as you sent it in this conversation.
workout.noSetsNote: Only completed sets are shown, never notes or effort ratings.

send.title: Send {name} in a message
send.description: Choose a conversation or a member. It opens attached in the message, where you can add a note before sending.
